title: Financial Planning and Analysis Specialist
description:
Confidential Company | Full-time

Work model: Hybrid, with 4 days per week working on-site in São Paulo .

About the opportunity:

We are looking for an FP&A Specialist to join the Finance team of a multinational company.

This professional will play an important role in the company's financial planning, forecasting, reporting and performance management processes , supporting the consolidation of financial information and providing relevant insights to support business and senior leadership decision-making.

The position will have strong exposure to different areas of the organization, working closely with Finance, Business and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the quality of financial information and support business performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate and consolidate the monthly forecasting and reporting processes .
  • Support the preparation and analysis of budgets, forecasts, estimates and long-range financial plans .
  • Monitor key financial and business performance indicators, identifying trends, variances and opportunities.
  • Develop financial analyses, projections and ad hoc reports to support business decisions and senior leadership .
  • Prepare and present financial information and insights to different stakeholders, translating data into actionable recommendations.
  • Partner with Finance, Business and cross-functional teams to improve reporting, planning, forecasting and analysis processes .
  • Identify opportunities to improve the accuracy, efficiency and quality of financial processes and reports.
  • Lead and monitor multiple projects and initiatives, ensuring delivery within established deadlines.
  • Act as a Finance partner, supporting stakeholders and contributing to business performance in a matrix and multicultural environment .

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or related areas .
  • 5+ years of experience in Finance, FP&A, Controllership, Accounting or related areas.
  • Strong financial and accounting knowledge, with solid experience in financial analysis .
  • Advanced experience with management reporting, budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning .
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with Power BI and financial reporting/consolidation tools .
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to work with large volumes of data and complex information.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to interact with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work under tight deadlines and operate in a dynamic environment.
  • Professional proficiency in English is mandatory.
  • Spanish is considered a plus.

What we are looking for

We are looking for a professional who combines strong financial expertise, analytical thinking and business acumen , with the ability to connect financial information to business performance.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working with senior stakeholders, navigating complex environments, challenging processes constructively and identifying opportunities to improve the way financial information is generated and used for decision-making.

  • Desenvolver e validar marcadores para utilização em seleção assistida por marcadores nos programas de melhoramento.
  • Desenhar, otimizar e validar ensaios de genotipagem por PCR.

  • Prospectar na literatura científica e em bancos de dados genéticos genes, variantes e marcadores moleculares de interesse para os programas de melhoramento genético.
  • Buscar e analisar sequências de genes e regiões genômicas de interesse em bancos de dados públicos e internos.
  • Interagir com pesquisadores das áreas de melhoramento genético, biotecnologia e genômica, transformando necessidades dos projetos em soluções de biologia molecular.

Requisitos:

Ensino Superior completo em Biologia, Biotecnologia ou áreas correlatas.

Desejável Doutorado em Genética, Biologia Molecular, Biotecnologia, Genômica, Melhoramento de Plantas ou áreas relacionadas.

Sólida experiência com Biologia molecular e marcadores moleculares.

Experiência com técnicas de PCR e genotipagem, especialmente TaqMan e KASP. E, com sequenciamento de DNA e análise de sequências.

Excel intermediário.

Inglês intermediário.

title: EHS Supervisor (environmental)
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce

Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure project activities follow local, state, and federal environmental regulations and company EHS standards.
  • Identify potential environmental hazards before and during project execution.
  • Monitor contractor activities and enforce EHS requirements
  • Conduct routine field checks to evaluate air, water, noise, waste management practices and other EHS topics.
  • Oversee the segregation, storage, transport, and final disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste.
  • Lead incident reporting and support investigations, ensuring corrective actions are implemented, focused on environmental events.
  • Promote environmental awareness through toolbox talks and on-site training
  • Prepare weekly, monthly, and compliance reports for management, customer and regulatory agencies (when applicable).
  • Support emergency preparedness, including drills and response coordination.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or technical qualification in Environmental, Engineering, or related fields
  • Proven experience in Environmental management within wind farm, construction, or energy projects
  • Strong knowledge of environmental management systems, effective communication, risk assessment, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Familiarity with local EHS regulations and standards
  • Experience supervising contractors on-site
  • Advanced English (for multinational environments)
  • Availability to work on-site and travel as required
